action_summary: Finds and fixes the reason the last two rounds had to be fixed: what an agent can state, plan and learn is bounded by what its vocabulary can NAME. The effect vocabulary was a hand-written four-shape table; measured on 44 (atom, state class) cells of five real machines, every one of its five names covers exactly two distinct transitions: PERSIST merges writing a new content with copying an existing one (FS_A1 vs FS_A4), and INERT merges a command that did nothing with the command that MOVES the world (FS_A2 vs FS_A3) -- the very step that satisfies the project's own moved_judge. The identity coordinate is already computed by effect_of and then discarded by the naming, and inconsistently: 11 hand operators do carry an identity change while the move that matters is INERT. Consequence measured: the hand model proves moved_judge unreachable, and one real command achieves it -- a sound proof about a wrong model. Naming an effect by its measured signature (arrived roles, departed roles, cardinality, identity delta) separates all 44 transitions at ZERO extra trials and zero parameters, because the observation was already taken.

agent_orientation.earlier_routes_exhausted_reason: Refused by measurement, in order: a hand-written vocabulary, relations over the reader, a goal handed in, the coarsest sufficient statistic, a free-running refinement loop, a supplied predicate called the goal, a syntactic count of statements, a price of the residual in words, the claim that the decision had to be read (a free attempt), the claim that the commit had to be one rename (a durable record), the claim that the last bit needs a question (a proof), and now the claim that the effect vocabulary is a design choice (it is a quotient of the probe).
agent_orientation.independent_verification_note: Producer-run sandbox only. Every number is a receipt row: 44 cells, five hand names each with two preimages, one cell where the world moved and the name is INERT, 11 hand operators that do carry an identity change, moved_judge achieved by one real command while the hand model refuses it, and zero extra trials for the derived vocabulary.
